title: clone koverstreet/bcachefs-tools into tools/
detail: git clone https://github.com/koverstreet/bcachefs-tools tools/ (full history for future rebases); record HEAD hash in docs/notes/01a-clone.md

title: deps audit: tools vs FreeBSD ports
detail: Read INSTALL.md + Makefile*; produce table dep->port/missing/stub; write docs/notes/02a-deps.md

title: install build deps via pkg (user-approved list)
detail: Base list: pkgconf liburcu e2fsprogs-libuuid lz4 fusefs-libs3 pjdfstest + T02 additions. ORCHESTRATOR-ONLY (needs user approval)

title: build C core (gmake), patch breakage into overlay/
detail: gmake; every failure -> minimal patch in overlay/, log docs/notes/04a-build-c.md; keyutils likely stubbed

title: cargo build (Rust side incl. fuser fork fetch)
test image: mdconfig vnode 2G + bcachefs format (our build)
detail: truncate -s 2G tmp/test.img; mdconfig -t vnode -f; ./bcachefs format --label test /dev/mdN; record in docs/notes/06a-testfs.md

title: fsck roundtrip on test image
detail: fsck clean; fill->fsync->fsck->readback->verify loop x3; log docs/notes/07a-fsck.md

title: kernel FUSE smoke via fuse-ufs port (control)
detail: kldload fusefs; pkg-installed fusefs-ufs mounts a UFS image read-only; proves kernel side without our code; log docs/notes/08a-fuse-ctrl.md

title: port Kent's fuser fork: build with libfuse feature on FreeBSD
detail: fuser (koverstreet/fuser@destroy-before-reply) with feature libfuse against fusefs-libs3; patches -> overlay/fuser/*; deviations from fuse-ufs recipe recorded; log docs/notes/09a-fuser.md

title: FUSE ro-mount of test fs + traversal + pjdfstest(ro)
detail: ./bcachefs mount -o fuse,ro /dev/mdN tmp/mnt; find/tar traversal; pjdfstest read-only group; log docs/notes/10a-fuse-ro.md

title: FUSE rw on TEST fs only: pjdfstest full + hardlink-farm simulation
detail: NEVER live pool; create/link/rename storm pattern of ed2k farms; log docs/notes/11a-fuse-rw.md

title: bench harness + run on FUSE mount
detail: bench/: sync-create, rename-storm, deep-readdir, seq r/w; run x5 iterations; log docs/notes/12a-bench-run.md

title: bench report vs bridge numbers
detail: docs/notes/bench-2026-11.md: bridge 12.8ms/file vs sshfs 1.2ms vs ours; verdict vs G3
